subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing fallback until a richer source-alignment contract exists?
rationale: Current main covers the single-image path, while the remaining linked PR changes shared message-delivery semantics for partial media resolution and prior review found that the contract choice affects correctness.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first/missing-middle coverage, and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the desired contract.

options.title: Track a narrower follow-up
options.body: Separate the partial-resolution edge from this single-image report if maintainers consider it distinct remaining work.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first/missing-middle coverage, and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the mixed image-order contract in the same resolver, which is the clearest decision point for partial delivery semantics.
